scenes.say: Do you share kajal or eyeliner with friends? Stop. Here's why.

scenes.en: Germs from one eyelid can travel on a pencil to yours.
scenes.ta: ஒருவரின் கண் கிருமிகள் பென்சில் வழியாக பரவும்
scenes.say: Your eyelids carry germs. A shared pencil can carry them from one person's eye to another, and cause an infection.

scenes.en: Kajal, eyeliner, mascara: one person, one set.
scenes.say: Don't share kajal, eyeliner or mascara. One person, one set.

scenes.en: Experts advise replacing mascara about every 3 months.
scenes.say: Did you know? Eye experts advise replacing mascara about every three months, because germs can grow inside the tube.

scenes.en: Sharpen pencils before use. Line outside the lashes, not the inner rim.
scenes.say: Do sharpen pencils before each use. And apply liner outside the lash line, not on the inner rim, where it can block tiny oil glands.
Never sleep in eye makeup. Remove it gently every night, with a clean cotton pad.

scenes.big: Stop and see a doctor if...
scenes.en: Eyes turn red, painful, swollen or sticky
scenes.say: If your eyes turn red, painful, swollen or sticky, stop all eye makeup, throw it away, and see an eye doctor.
Healthy eyes look the best. Book an eye test today.
